Your "Spanish verbs" note now has a flashcard page. Open the note and switch to **Page** to use it. I haven't opened it in the app, so I haven't tested it.

- **Flipping:** Tap a card to flip between the Spanish verb and its English meaning. The Prev and Next buttons move through the deck.
- **Remembering:** Tap **I know it** or **Still learning** on each card. Your answers are saved in a new "Known" column in the note's table, so they stay put between sessions. All 12 verbs start as "No".
- **Order:** Only the verbs you don't know yet are shown. "Include known" adds the ones you've learned to the end of the deck. When you know them all, you can review everything or reset your progress.
- **Layout:** It works on a phone screen and in light or dark mode, and a progress bar shows how many verbs you know.

I added the "Known" column by rewriting the note body. The earlier version is in the note's history if you want it back.
